text: Maybe nice for praying.. Hotep family. This reminds me of a chair out of the 70s. I thought it would be very good on my back because I'm at a computer a lot of the times Jack. But after a while this is very uncomfortable child. I don't know what to do, it might work for you but for me I'm giving it A3 you see. I still recommend because that might be what you need in the end my friend. Thank you for looking at my review. I hope it is helpful for you. If it was, please let me know by simply checking that helpful box below. God bless you. May the rest of your life be the best of your life.  Baba Oran Z

product_metadata.title: ZAULZ Kneeling Chair 20.5"x13.8" with Armrest & Backrest - Adjustable Kneeler Stool with Back Support - Ergonomic Seating with Angled Seat, Memory Foam Cushion for Home & Office - 330Lbs. Capacity
features: 🪑 Sit Upright & Fix Your Posture: This ergonomic chair with a tilted seat lets you sit at an open hip angle. This encourages an upright posture that helps align your back, shoulders, and neck.
🪑 Heavy-Duty Support: The frame is made from 1.5mm thick tubes. This and the state-of-the-art manufacturing lend exceptional durability to the chair, allowing for a 330 lbs. max load capacity.
🪑 Adjust To Your Requirements: The seat, knee pads, and footrests can be adjusted into multiple heights and angles. As such, it can accommodate tall and short individuals and atypical desk heights.
🪑 Stay Comfy: Fitted with premium paddings on the seat, backrest, knee pads, and footrests. The memory foam with soft gel layer provides excellent support and prevents uncomfortable pressure points.
🪑 A Bundle to Meet All Your Office Needs: Aside from the kneeling chair, this workstation package also includes a wooden roller, posture corrector, LED lamp, ergonomic keyboard and mouse pad.
